hero.title: Abdelrahman Ragab Abdelbaky
hero.description: Frontend Developer with 1.5+ years of professional experience building scalable e-commerce, LMS, and marketplace applications using React, Next.js, and Magento 2. Experienced in developing SSR and PWA applications with GraphQL, optimizing Core Web Vitals, improving SEO, integrating GA4/GTM, and building multilingual (AR/EN) applications with RTL/LTR support. Skilled in building reusable UI components, robust frontend architectures, and delivering production-ready user experiences in Agile teams.
